title: Houston heat anomaly -> Henry Hub
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Houston temperature anomaly 20d z-score > 1.5 (cooling burn) leads Henry Hub log returns by 2 days (+) narrowing the TTF ratio; trade long NG=F 3d [weather.houston.temp_anomaly -> finance.NG=F.log_return]
message: Weak/unsupported directionally: r=0.013 (n=388), best lag 3d r=0.18; long NG=F 3d hit rate 47.5%, excess return negative in-sample, OOS n=13 mildly positive. Not actionable.

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.houston.temp_anomaly rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long NG=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 3 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Houston temperature anomaly 20d z-score > 1.5 leads Henry Hub absolute returns (volatility, not direction) by 3 days (+); trade long NG=F straddle proxy 3d [weather.houston.temp_anomaly -> finance.NG=F.abs_return] (parent: R2-0035)
